verdict.rationale: Elastic's own observability page says its 'nightshift AI SRE' detects and investigates incidents and delivers an evidence-backed root cause, which is the story's capability. A natural-language interface over telemetry supports it. The evidence is a single marketing-level claim with no supporting depth. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how the AI investigation is triggered from a specific alert or error, details on how root-cause hypotheses are produced and presented, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have the platform's AI investigate an alert or error and propose a probable root cause

citations.quote: Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
